Market stance

The group turns defensive into NVDA earnings: breakouts keep failing, growth is getting wrecked, and the only long qualifier is DiCarlo's ADBE base while Remz shorts AMD under 501.

Key watches

Catalysts

  • NVDA earnings Tue Nov 17, after close — Enrich: “the next catalyst to catch a bid”; the first call under interim CEO Colette Kress
  • Q3 13Fs are out — Enrich and Venu both recap the filings: Renaissance +MU 619% (now its largest holding) and +UNH 507%; Appaloosa +SPCX 1,626% and +MU 28%; Baker +CIEN 51%, ~2x ALAB, cut MU; Cohen opened ~$682M CLS; Tepper +MU/LRCX; Bridgewater +MU/AMAT; Druckenmiller held 99% of NTRA through a 52% Q3 rally
  • Situational Awareness fund plunges over 90% — Prof: “BREAKING: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness fund plunges over 90%”
  • Dell Foundation exits DELL — Remz: the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation exited its position, per the Q3 13F
  • $ANT IPO Thursday + FOMC minutes Wednesday — carried scheduled events from Enrich's Nov 16 week forecast

Market — SPY · QQQ · IWM · TLT

Macro overlay — from their posts, not our data
Monday was a down day across the board and the group reads it as a market to sit out, not to buy. Sean says it plainest: “The truth is most people would be better off not trading right now” — and then demonstrates it, day 1 of his $10k challenge with 0 trades taken: “Sometimes the best trade is no trade.” Prof supplies the breadth: “Welcome to Moan-day. - 75% of the stock market is down today - 50% of that is down 2% or more. Growth is getting wrecked.” iain sets the condition for getting aggressive again — “a constructive HL, group participation + liquid leaders setting up again” — and until then “I'm leaning toward more downside.” Enrich's tape read agrees: QQQ “stuck in the 11/5 range. Bear flags below HTF EMAs + strong selling volume. Losing support risks acceleration lower.” Remz puts the levels on the broad market with his SPX chart: a three-month top at 7,560–7,840, the 7,580 retest failing, invalidated above 7,600, with the 200-day at 7,343, the June low at 7,150 and the March shelf at 6,750 below. The one name with a defined trade is AMD: Remz's gravestone doji at $500, short under 501, targets 475 then 450, wrong above 526. The one long qualifier is ADBE: DiCarlo's first bullish weekly sign in almost two years, with a $355 target — and it was the only green name in the feed. Everything else the group names is a warning or a watch against a broken chart: Prof's MSFT triple top with $450/$400 targets, iain's MSTR avoid (“another -20% flush into the 80s”), Enrich's downside list (DELL, CAT, MU) and his upside list (AVGO, BE, RIOT, SPCX) where the charts say the names are still in decline. The 13Fs cut both ways on MU — Renaissance made it its largest holding while Enrich lists it downside and Baker cut it — and the Dell Foundation walking away from DELL is the week's cleanest institutional tell. Tonight's NVDA print is the next test: the stock is at a new 52-week low into the first call under interim CEO Colette Kress, and Remz's New York Post story keeps the succession question in the frame. Your process gives one genuine long qualifier with a trigger above the close (ADBE, reclaim 269.02) and one defined short (AMD, under 501.00) — plus AVGO as the contested name, where DiCarlo's “best setup” call meets a chart still under every average. The declines, not entries: NVDA at a new 52-week low into earnings, MSTR at a new 3-month low, and BE, MU, DELL and CAT all down 5–8% in a day with no base. The discipline is in the framing: the indexes lost their 30-week trends and QQQ is under its 50-week EMA too — so the framework says wait for a hold above the triggers, or a pullback into the averages, and tonight's NVDA print decides whether the week gets a bid.

  • Level strength: Strong = 2+ confluent anchors (52w high/low, 3m swing, 50-day EMA, 30-week MA, 50-week EMA, trader-stated) within 0.75%, or a 52w extreme with 3+ weekly touches in the past year. Moderate = 1 anchor or 2–3 touches. Light = anything else. Touches count weeks whose high or low came within 0.75% of the level. Duplicate prices merge into one row carrying both labels. NVDA's invalidation 156.14 is today's close and the 52-week low. MSTR's invalidation 82.31 is the 52-week low. AMD's trigger 501.00 and invalidation 526.00 are Remz's stated levels (targets 475, then 450, 200-day 424). MSFT's downside targets 450.00 and 400.00 are Prof's stated levels.
